'''Tanya Louise Beckett''' (born 11 July 1966)<ref>{{Cite web |date=2005-08-19 |title=Tanya Beckett |url=https://www.tvnewsroom.co.uk/biography-images/tanya-beckett-3319/ |access-date=2022-04-24 |website=TV Newsroom |language=en}}</ref> is an English television and radio journalist.

==Early life==
Beckett was born in 1966 in [[Maldon]], [[Essex]]. She has one brother.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2014-06-15 |title=Windsurfing behind the Iron Curtain |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/business-27779845 |access-date=2022-04-24 |website=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref> She was educated at the independent [[Redland High School for Girls]]<ref>from 1976 to 1984 verified by Jane Butterworth Director of Development at Redland High School</ref> in [[Bristol]], [[England]], followed by [[Pembroke College, Oxford]], where she gained a degree in metallurgy and materials science and a Blue in [[fencing]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/profiles/3kQsZ2sXkQb2Np32bVGTRvf/tanya-beckett|title=BBC World News - Business Edition with Tanya Beckett - Tanya Beckett|website=BBC}}</ref>

==Career==
Beckett undertook research on the properties of [[carbon fibre|carbon]] and [[glass fibre]]s for [[Courtaulds]]. She spent four years working as an [[investment banker]] for [[Citibank]] in London and [[Commerzbank]] in Frankfurt, Germany; consequently, she speaks fluent German and French.<ref>{{cite web |title=Tanya Beckett |url=https://www.specialistspeakers.com/?p=2388 |access-date=6 January 2026 |website=Specialist Speakers}}</ref>

After training as a journalist, Beckett joined [[CNBC Europe]] in 1993 as a business and political reporter. She spent her career presenting business news for broadcasters including [[NBC Europe]] and [[CNBC Europe]], [[LBC|News Direct Radio 97.3]] in London, [[Sky News]] and [[CNN International]].

Beckett joined the [[BBC]] in June 1998. Since then, she has been a presenter for programmes such as [[BBC Two]]'s ''[[Working Lunch]]'' in 1998, ''[[BBC Breakfast]]'', ''[[The Daily Global|The World Today]]'' on [[BBC One]] and, from 2001, [[BBC News (British TV channel)|BBC News Channel]] and [[BBC News (international TV channel)|BBC World News]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bbc.co.uk/pressoffice/biographies/biogs/bbc_world/tanyabeckett.shtml |title=BBC - Press Office - Tanya Beckett |accessdate=2010-03-10 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110207105427/http://www.bbc.co.uk/pressoffice/biographies/biogs/bbc_world/tanyabeckett.shtml |archivedate=7 February 2011 |df=dmy-all }} BBC bio</ref> Beckett moved her young family to New York City while helping to present the ''[[World Business Report]]'' from an office in [[Times Square]], but returned to London three years later.<ref>{{cite web |title=Tanya Beckett |url=https://champions-speakers.co.uk/speaker-agent/tanya-beckett/ |access-date=6 January 2026 |website=Champions Speakers Agency}}</ref>

She presently works on the [[BBC World Service]], as a relief presenter on the news channel and successor to World Business Report ''[[Business Today (BBC News programme)|Business Today]]'', as well as ''The World Today'', and from June 2015 started to present ''Talking Business'' on the BBC News Channel. She also presents TV version of ''Witness'' a monthly highlights programme of stories told by the people who were there.{{cn|date=March 2025}}

==Personal life==
After studying together, and then meeting at a college reunion in 1998, on 16 September 2001 Beckett married the Hon. [[Edward Charles d'Olier Gibson]] (born 31 December 1967), son of and heir then apparent to [[Baron Ashbourne]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ashbourne locked 5th Baron cr 1885 (Edward Charles d’Olier Gibson) |url=https://www.ukwhoswho.com/display/10.1093/ww/9780199540884.001.0001/ww-9780199540884-e-294958}}</ref> The couple have three children.<ref>{{Cite web |title=How She Does It {{!}} Positive Luxury |url=http://www.positiveluxury.com/2011/09/how-she-does-it/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111005034400/http://www.positiveluxury.com/2011/09/how-she-does-it/ |archive-date=2011-10-05 |access-date=2026-03-26 |website=www.positiveluxury.com |language=en-US}}</ref> She lives in the village of [[Lewknor, Oxfordshire]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Aristocrat who says he doesn't know what a policeman looks like has appeal rejected |url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/uknews/crime/11263999/Aristocrat-who-says-he-doesnt-know-what-a-policeman-looks-like-has-appeal-rejected.html |website=}}</ref>

In November 2013, d'Olier Gibson appeared in [[Oxford]] [[magistrates' court]] after allegedly assaulting Beckett at their home during a discussion over their possible divorce. Beckett called the police, who in trying to restrain d'Olier Gibson used [[pepper spray]] and struck him with a baton. Having discovered a missing shotgun, he was eventually arrested after armed police were called to the property. d'Olier Gibson was charged with assaulting both Beckett and arresting officer PC Aaron Walker; he denied both charges.<ref name="tel">{{cite news| url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/uknews/law-and-order/10416930/Barons-son-accused-of-assaulting-police-officer-and-presenter-wife-following-row-about-divorce.html | location=London | work=The Daily Telegraph | first=Claire | last=Carter | title=Baron's son accused of assaulting police officer and presenter wife following row about divorce | date=31 October 2013}}</ref> Convicted for his "sustained and drunken" attack on PC Walker, he was ordered to wear an [[electronic tag]] for two months and given a curfew. On release, d'Olier Gibson started divorce proceedings.<ref name="Telg10451158">{{cite news|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/women/sex/divorce/10451158/Barons-son-blames-BBC-for-divorce-from-presenter-wife.html|title=Baron's son 'blames BBC for divorce from presenter wife'|author=Miranda Prynne|work=[[The Daily Telegraph]]|date=15 November 2013|accessdate=20 November 2013|location=London}}</ref>
